about: Inputs shared by backend/src/test/java/dev/pulse/ParityTest.java and web/src/lite/parity.test.ts. The Java code is the reference: the expected values are written by it (PULSE_PARITY_WRITE=1 ./gradlew test --tests dev.pulse.ParityTest) and the browser copy in web/src/lite must give the same.

walls.about: A book symmetric around the mid. The server takes the median of buckets inside the snapshot's coverage only (beyond it a live book is sparse); the demo works on a full REST snapshot and cuts at maxDistancePct instead. On a symmetric book both rules keep the same buckets.
